$comment: Briefs for measuring what an agent builds with this skill. Score an output with scripts/eval-score.mjs. Format follows the skill-creator evals schema plus slug, pageType, kind and machine checks.

evals.prompt: Build a landing page for "Tally", an invoicing tool for freelancers. It should make people trust it with their money and get them to start a free trial. Use the lumina-taste skill. Write the result to index.html (plus any css/js files) in the output folder.
evals.expected_output: A complete landing page that passes the audit and the taste critic.
expectations: Ran compose.mjs (or followed its plan) before writing markup
Taste profile written and tokens used; no raw hex colours in component CSS
node scripts/audit-ui.mjs reports 0 errors at 390px and 1440px, light and dark
Taste score (audit-ui --taste) is 90 or more
No placeholder copy (lorem ipsum, Acme, John Doe) and no hype words
One primary action per screen
